name: Mirrorform — each nonland permanent you control becomes a copy of the picked permanent
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "Each nonland permanent you control becomes a copy of target non-Aura permanent." A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies. Hill Giant picked: Grizzly Bears and Sol Ring become Hill Giants, the Forest does not, and the spell's own row is untouched.
